title: More ability: which model family to try first, from real tables screened by the engine, and homework whose layout says nothing
request: The owner: 'go ahead with the generator package, non-stop; we are very focused on leakage in DCLab, we want more ability; the student model must have more ability'.
spec: docs/guides/STUDENTS_100_PLAN.md S7: G1 benchgen v3, G2 screens on real tables, G3 the student, G4 use after an exam and the owner's switch.
plan: Measure whether self-play can teach the ability.
A new point before the screen, with a rule to beat.
Real tables through the engine, the truth measured.
Craft tables with planted structures and decoys, the winner measured.
A student judged by hit, fairness and regret beside two baselines.

decisions.decision: The ability is model.first, the family tried before the screen, not model.family.
decisions.why: The engine screens every family and keeps the measured best: model.family has no rule to beat; a first guess does (the kind's fixed order).

decisions.decision: Real tables are the homework; craft tables an arm of their own.
decisions.why: Self-play's 'always the generator's usual winner' is right 70%: invented tables teach the generator.

decisions.decision: A pick is judged by hit, fairness (within the folds' noise) and capped regret.
decisions.why: Two families within noise are equally good first tries; exact match alone would punish a fair pick.

decisions.decision: Screens run the product's own settings, never the acceptance harness's fast profile.
decisions.why: The fast profile cuts ensembles to ten trees and changes who wins.

decisions.decision: Every screen line also keeps each feature recipe's training-fold score, the recipe chosen and the model it was screened with.
decisions.why: Layer 3 of the owner's map (build): a second student, which recipe to try first, reads the same screens; recording it now saves running every table twice.

change: dclab_core/ledger.py (model.first, the table-at-a-glance fields, 'of'), dclab_core/benchgen3.py (new), dclab_core 0.112.0 and its CHANGELOG, adapters/conformance.py; dclab_rnd/ledger/states.py (table_state, coarse_task), ledger/capture.py (model.first in the models stage), ledger/__init__.py, kinds/acceptance.py (engine_run fast=), real_screen.py and first_family.py (new), archive.py; tests test_benchgen_v3, test_first_family, test_real_screen; STUDENTS_100_PLAN S7.

findings.defect: Self-play teaches the generator, not the table.
findings.scenario: 1,116 self-play screens: 'always the kind's usual winner' right 70%; logistic regression wins 99 of 100 binary replicas.
findings.cause: Each replica generator has a fixed structure (and they run the fast profile).
findings.fix: Real OpenML tables screened by the engine; craft tables with drawn structures as a separate arm.

findings.defect: The truth was measured under the unit-test profile.
findings.scenario: Fast versus full on the same craft table: xgboost against lightgbm; on a skewed table LightGBM's MAE 347 against 69.
findings.fix: engine_run(fast=False) for screens; each screen says its profile; first_family reads full screens only; the three fast screens kept apart.

findings.defect: Binary and regression tables lost their task in the state.
findings.scenario: record task_type 'binary_imbalanced' is not in TASKS; commonest keyed every task under 'None'.
findings.cause: Only exact task names were mapped.
findings.fix: coarse_task in table_state; commonest keyed on the screen's own task.

findings.defect: The class balance was missing from the state.
findings.scenario: The plan's state includes it; table_state had none.
findings.fix: positive_rate band from the bundle's spec; usable_features too.

findings.defect: Two state fields named the craft structure.
findings.scenario: high_card_columns > 0 on 35 of 35 high_card tables and 0 of 265 others; date_columns likewise for seasonal.
findings.fix: No-effect big categories and dates in any structure, one name pool and one value format for both.

findings.scenario: The ledger's label is the clear best; first_family used the best mean, tagged benchmark.
findings.fix: Homework: the best mean, tagged measured; the clear winners judged apart (clear_hit), as the ledger's label.

findings.scenario: The commonest baseline counted craft screens; 30 tables could all be craft.
findings.fix: Baselines from real training screens; at least 30 real; two arms reported.

findings.defect: A zero spread made an infinite regret that the mean silently dropped.
findings.fix: A noise floor and a cap of twenty; an unscored pick counts as the cap.

findings.defect: A failure's text could carry a cell value.
findings.scenario: pandas: could not convert string to float: '<a value>'.

findings.defect: Craft details: missing values on the structure's own column, 'skewed' meaningless for classes, a row sample shuffled, no memory check.
findings.scenario: Two thirds of high_card and seasonal tables had gaps on the structure's column.
findings.cause: Insertion-order choice; a quantile cut of a monotone signal.
findings.fix: Gaps on columns drawn at random apart from the structure's; a rare positive class for 'skewed'; sort_index after sampling; memory in room().

measurements.name: the first real tables
measurements.gate: affected tests only (the owner's daytime rule)
measurements.result: 774 real tables declare an outcome (545 train, 107 dev, 122 sealed); 2 of the first 3 crashed the engine (fixed apart); one full-profile screen about 13 to 50 s; 53 tests in 6 files pass; dclab-core 0.112.0's wheel runs in a clean Python 3.12
limits: no student trained yet: the screens run in the background

measurements.name: recipes on each screen
measurements.gate: affected tests only (the owner's daytime rule)
measurements.result: tests/test_real_screen.py passes (4); the running screen was restarted so every new line carries its recipes
limits: lines written before the restart (one table) have no recipes

outcome: The new ability's homework is being measured on real tables under the product's own settings; its student, judge and generator are built and tested.
lessons: Measure a truth the way the product will act on it: a test profile's winners are not the product's.
Every count in a state is a possible tell: test the state's fields, not only the table's width.
risks: Full-profile screens take longer: the 652 train and dev tables need about a day of the Mac's spare time.
G4 (use) waits for a passed exam and the owner's switch.
